inj.note: Washington placed Kinlaw on injured reserve Tuesday, but it wasn't immediately known how much time the knee injury he initially sustained Week 6 would keep him out of commission. Now that Kinlaw has opted for surgery, he'll remain on IR for the Commanders' final 10 games in what amounts to another major hit to the defensive line. Washington also placed nose tackle Daron Payne on IR on Tuesday after he needed surgery to repair a Jones fracture in his left foot.
inj.label: Out for season

news.h: Source: Commanders lose another DL with Kinlaw out for season after knee surgery
news.d: The Commanders lost a second defensive line starter for the season in less than a week as Javon Kinlaw underwent season-ending knee surgery.
